description: AICTIONBOT™ RASCI Checker by KULIC Advisory. Checks a RASCI matrix (tasks by roles or people, codes R, A, S, C, I, also A/R) against an optional people list (role, status, leaving date, absence). Returns the tasks that need action: no accountable role, several A, no R, too many R or C, and roles or people that hold an A or R but left, are absent or are unknown. Deterministic, no AI, nothing stored. Requests without sign-in are limited to 20 KB.

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

people.description: Optional people list: person, role, status (active, left, absent), left_on (YYYY-MM-DD), absent_until (YYYY-MM-DD).

tasks.description: One object per task: task (name), process (optional), assignments (object: role or person name -> code such as R, A, A/R, S, C, I). Instead of assignments the role names may be given as further keys of the task object.

name: check_rasci_matrix
title: Check a RASCI matrix against the people list: tasks without an A, several A, no R, roles without an active person
